The whole PG is very well maintained to a high standard (It gives you a feel of a hotel room). They have an in-house caretaker/cook who takes care of the PG and prepares meals. The meals themselves are nutritious and tasty. The owner takes care to ensure that the community residing in the PG are all sound characters who live in harmony. Essential services like pick-and-drop laundry are available for cheap prices nearby. The PG is near the main road and transport options like auto are available. The lane for entering into the PG might seem off-putting, but as they say 'You shouldn't judge a book by it's cover'. The warm hospitality and homely feel provided by the PG more than compensate for it.

Overall, my stay here was very pleasant and I'd recommend it for any working professional who is looking for a value-for-money accommodation.
